words.gloss: by the nature of the action

literal: Even when examined and trusted in every possible way, those who become different by the nature of the action are many people.
translation: Even after being tested and trusted in every possible way, there are many people who change their nature when confronted with the actual demands of a task.
modern: எந்த வழிகளில் ஆராய்ந்து தெளிந்த போதிலும், செய்யும் செயலின் தன்மையால் வேறுபட்டுப் போகும் மனிதர்கள் பலர் இருக்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights a practical challenge in selecting people for tasks. A person might pass every test of character, loyalty, and capability beforehand. However, when they are assigned a specific task, the pressure, temptations, or nature of that work can cause them to change and behave differently. The poet warns that initial trust is not a guarantee of final performance, as many people alter their behavior under the influence of actual responsibility.
